title: iPSC to Dopaminergic Neurons
author: Elisangela Bressan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfpzjmp6

steps.title: Plate iPSC to 70‑80% confluence
steps.instruction: Grow iPSC on matrigel‑coated plates in Essential E8 Flex medium until the cells cover 70‑80 % of the well area.

steps.title: Verify pluripotent morphology
steps.instruction: Observe the cultures with a bright‑field microscope; colonies should show high nuclear‑to‑cytoplasm ratio, prominent nucleolus and densely packed morphology.

steps.title: Dissociate and re‑plate iPSC
steps.instruction: Treat the cells with Accutase for ~30 min at 37 °C to obtain a single‑cell suspension, then plate 200 000 cells / cm² in Essential E8 Flex medium (200 µL / cm²) supplemented with 10 µM Y‑27632. Prepare the new plates by coating with the same matrigel concentration used for iPSC growth, incubating the coating for 12 h at 37 °C and using the plates immediately.

steps.title: Start differentiation (day 0)
steps.instruction: When the replated iPSC reach 100 % confluence (usually 24–48 h), replace the medium with KSR differentiation medium (200 µL / cm²) containing the small‑molecule schedule listed below.

substeps.instruction: Day 1‑3: add 1 mM SHH, 2 µM Purmorphamine, 100 ng/mL FGF‑8b (keep LDN193189 and SB431542)
Day 3‑5: add 3 µM CHIR99021 (keep previous factors)
Day 5‑7: 100 nM LDN193189, 1 mM SHH, 2 µM Purmorphamine, 100 ng/mL FGF‑8b, 3 µM CHIR99021 (SB431542 omitted)
Day 7‑9: 100 nM LDN193189, 1 mM SHH, 3 µM CHIR99021

steps.title: Prepare KSR medium
steps.instruction: Mix 409.5 mL knockout DMEM/F‑12, 75 mL knockout serum replacement (15 %), 5 mL GlutaMAX (2 mM), 5 mL MEM non‑essential amino acids (1 %), 0.5 mL 2‑mercaptoethanol (55 µM) and 5 mL Penicillin‑Streptomycin (1 %). Store at 4 °C for ≤1 week or at –20 °C for ≤4 weeks (without small molecules or growth factors).

steps.title: Prepare N2 medium and blend with KSR
steps.instruction: Make N2 medium by mixing 475 mL Neurobasal, 5 mL N2 supplement (1 %), 10 mL B27 supplement (2 %), 5 mL GlutaMAX (2 mM) and 5 mL Penicillin‑Streptomycin (1 %). Store as above. From day 5 replace KSR with the following KSR/N2 ratios:

steps.instruction: Combine 485 mL Neurobasal, 10 mL B27 supplement (2 %) and 5 mL Penicillin‑Streptomycin (1 %). Store as above. From day 11 replace the KSR/N2 mixture with this NB/B27 medium supplemented with:

steps.title: Dissociate precursors on day 25
steps.instruction: Treat dopaminergic precursors with Accutase for ~40 min at 37 °C, then plate 400 000 cells / cm² on plates pre‑coated with 0.1 mg/mL poly‑L‑ornithine, 10 µg/mL laminin and 2 µg/mL fibronectin. Culture in differentiation medium (NB/B27 + all supplements listed in step 7 plus 10 µM Y‑27632) until day 26.

substeps.instruction: Avoid storing differentiation medium that contains small molecules and growth factors.
Dopaminergic precursors may be frozen on day 25.
Optional: re‑plate at 100 000 cells / cm² on day 32 for single‑cell imaging.

steps.title: Media change on day 26
steps.instruction: Perform a media change (200 µL / cm²) to remove dead cells and debris; add freshly prepared differentiation medium as in step 8 but omit Y‑27632.

steps.title: Routine media changes from day 29
steps.instruction: Starting on day 29, replace the differentiation medium every 3–4 days with the same formulation as used on day 26.

steps.title: Process cells on day 65
steps.instruction: On day 65 of differentiation, harvest the cells and carry out the desired downstream assays.
